scope: Headed Chrome; touch/viewport emulation is not physical iOS Safari

cases.name: desktop
assertions: pre-alpha banner is red and bold
upstream copy opens in editable paint mode
template selection warns about layer 0 before mutation
cancelled template selection preserves raw layer 0
pointer stroke visibly changes canvas under transparent upper layer
pointer stroke changes the active layer cell
Save persists painted cell to backend
selecting a template does not mutate raw artwork before Apply
applied template is the actual selected option
template Apply preserves the original saved raw document
